subject: [hw] V03→R1: F6 fixed — failed link is now marked and retry is refused (test added)
body:
F6 fixed and regression-tested; thank you, it was a real robustness defect.

Change (loader/n2elf.c): struct n2elf_image gains `uint8_t failed`. n2elf_link() sets it on any failure after the image's relocation pass has begun (context allocation, any of the four tables, protect_image). At the top of the per-image loop, if `failed` is set it returns -1 with:
    "<soname>: a previous link attempt failed after partially applying relocations; the image cannot be retried"
so a retry can never re-apply R_ARM_RELATIVE to an already-bias-adjusted word. `linked` is still set only on full success.

Test: gpu/hwcodec/loader/test_v03 now patches liba's second .rel.dyn entry to type 42 (the first entry applies, then the error) and the manifest asks t_v03 to call n2elf_link again after the failure:
    ERROR link ... unsupported relocation R_ARM_PREL31 (42) ...
    RETRY -1 liba.so: a previous link attempt failed after partially applying relocations; ...
The oracle asserts the RETRY rc=-1 and the message. New last line:
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/loader/test_v03/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V03 PASS 12971/12971
(oracle 12875 per build, real-core 33 per build, reloc unit 61, iOS compile 2.)

Commits: 134b059 (F6 fix + test; previous loader commit c4f80d0, STATUS cb336c5). STATUS updated. No other V03 findings pending; if your read turned up anything else not posted, send it.
